candidates.name: LangGraph
candidates.security_review: recent 2026 advisories require version/security review before activation

candidates.name: Prefect
candidates.python_compatibility_review: PyPI/project metadata supports Python >=3.10,<3.15 as reviewed 2026-09-15

v1_decision.core: Phoenix-specific deterministic governance remains standard-library only
v1_decision.reason: risk policy, exact-scope gates and Phoenix evidence semantics are product-specific
v1_decision.oss_reuse: adapter interfaces are registered now; installation is deferred until integration is exercised

v1_low_risk_execution_decision.fallback: GitPython; Dulwich remains Git implementation fallback
v1_low_risk_execution_decision.reason: native Git already exists in PHOENIX and provides isolated linked worktrees without an extra dependency

v1_low_risk_mainline_promotion_decision.backup_primary: native Git bundle --all plus full filesystem snapshot
v1_low_risk_mainline_promotion_decision.reason: --ff-only refuses divergent integration; bundle backs up refs while filesystem snapshot preserves local repository state

v1_low_risk_self_improvement_decision.active_v1_runtime: PHOENIX deterministic bounded coordinator reusing existing LOW-risk executor + promoter
v1_low_risk_self_improvement_decision.reason: v1 is a single bounded local cycle and already has deterministic PHOENIX governance, Git isolation and promotion primitives; adding a new runtime dependency is not necessary for correctness. Prefect is the preferred future scheduler/retry adapter; LangGraph remains a fallback after security review.
